场景购不是另一个商品搜索框。它先理解你正在完成什么生活任务，再拆分清单、安排优先: SceneCart starts with the real-life task you want to complete, then breaks it into a checklist, sets priorities, allocates your budget and organizes products into a shopping plan you can refine.
新车、露营、房间、宿舍、搬家: New car, camping, room, dorm or moving
用户始终保留最终判断: You always make the final decision
场景购公开 Demo 首页，用户可以输入购物场景、预算和偏好: SceneCart public demo homepage, with inputs for your shopping scenario, budget and preferences
商品不难找，难的是先想清楚: Finding products is easy. The hard part is knowing
传统电商适合承接明确单品。面对新车首购、露营准备或搬家置办，用户真正需要的是一套: Traditional e-commerce works well when you already know the item. For a new car, a camping trip or a move, you need a coordinated set of decisions around one task.
把预算、偏好、已有物品与排除项放在一起理解，不让单个关键词割裂真实需求。: Consider budget, preferences, existing items and exclusions together, so a single keyword never fragments the real need.
先拆模块、再分预算；必要项优先，体验升级项可以延后，避免买漏与冲动购买。: Break the task into categories and allocate the budget. Put essentials first and leave upgrades for later, reducing omissions and impulse purchases.
推荐不只给商品，还保留适配理由、候选比较与调整入口，让用户知道为什么买。: Each recommendation includes a reason, alternatives and a way to adjust it, so you understand why it belongs in your plan.
AI 跑完复杂度，用户只在关键节点确认: AI handles the steps. You confirm the decisions.
从需求到购物清单，所有阶段围绕同一个 Session 连续推进；页面关闭或短暂断: Every stage runs within the same session, from the initial request to the shopping list. Resume the task after closing the page or a brief disconnection.
描述任务、预算、偏好和不想买的内容。: Explain the task, budget, preferences and exclusions.
Agent 拆解模块、优先级与预算，用户可以直接修改。: The agent proposes categories, priorities and budgets for you to edit.
按模块查看主推荐、证据与备选，并继续补搜。: Review the main recommendation, evidence and alternatives by category, and request more options.
用户逐件确认是否加入购物车；系统不会自动下单或支付。: Confirm each item before adding it to the cart. The system never places orders or makes payments automatically.

练一下首页，展示训练统计、今日任务和开始训练按钮: FitLog homepage showing training statistics, today's tasks and the start button
打开就能开始，不先做一轮配置。: Start right away, without a setup session.
不注册账号也能记录，数据先保存在自己的浏览器里。: Log workouts without creating an account. Your data starts in your own browser.
重量、组数、次数和难度都围绕训练现场设计。: Weight, sets, reps and difficulty are designed for the gym floor.
可安装为 PWA，网络不稳定时仍能打开核心界面。: Install it as a PWA and open the core interface even with an unstable connection.
需要跨设备时，再主动使用同步码开启云端同步。: When you need multiple devices, choose to enable cloud sync with a sync code.
训练已经够累，记录不该更累: Training takes effort. Logging should not.
这个项目来自一个很具体的个人问题：现有健身应用经常把内容、社交和复杂配置放在训练: This project started with a specific frustration: fitness apps often put content, social features and setup before the workout. The few seconds between sets deserve more attention.
它不是教你练什么，而是帮你把正在练的事记清楚。: It helps you record your training clearly.
面向已有训练习惯、习惯按自己计划开练的人。产品不争夺注意力，不创造社交压力，也不: Built for people who already train and follow their own plans. The product avoids competing for attention or creating social pressure, and does not make medical or training decisions for you.
备忘录、表格和聊天窗口很难连续复盘。: Notes, spreadsheets and chats make continuous review difficult.
多层表单会打断动作之间的节奏。: Layers of forms interrupt the rhythm between exercises.
账号门槛与封闭格式让迁移变得困难。: Account requirements and closed formats make migration difficult.
从想练，到练完，只走三步: Three steps, from ready to finished
路径围绕一次真实训练展开。没有信息流，没有连续弹窗，也不要求先建立完整计划。: The flow follows a real workout, with no feed, repeated pop-ups or requirement to build a complete plan first.
选部位，一键开练: Choose a muscle group and start
按今日建议开始，或自己组合胸、背、肩、腹、胳膊、腿和有氧。动作清单在进入训练前就: Follow today's suggestion or combine chest, back, shoulders, abs, arms, legs and cardio. Preview the exercise list before you begin.
练一下开练页，可选择训练部位并预览动作: FitLog start screen for choosing muscle groups and previewing exercises
组间快速记下真实完成: Record what you complete, between sets
训练中直接调整重量、组数、次数和难度。临时改变计划没有负担，退出前的草稿也可以恢: Adjust weight, sets, reps and difficulty during training. Change the plan freely and recover the draft when you return.
重量快速增减与精确输入: Quick weight adjustments and precise input
练一下训练中界面，可调整每个动作的重量、组次与难度: FitLog workout screen with weight, sets, reps and difficulty controls
按日期、部位和动作回看记录。历史、日历与部位状态共同回答：最近练了什么，多久没练: Review by date, muscle group or exercise. History, the calendar and muscle-group status show what you trained, how long it has been and where to pick up next.
练一下历史记录页，可按月份和训练部位查看训练: FitLog history screen filtered by month and muscle group
四个界面，一条完整闭环: Four screens. One complete workout cycle.
点击切换真实产品状态。每个界面都只保留当前阶段真正需要的信息与动作。: Switch between real product screens. Each stage shows the information and actions you need at that moment.
打开就知道今天怎么开始: Know how to start as soon as you open it
首页把训练统计、今日建议、最近记录与部位状态放在一起，但最醒目的动作始终只有一个: The homepage brings together stats, today's suggestion, recent records and muscle-group status. One action stands out: start training.
无需注册即可开始体验。数据默认保存在当前浏览器，请在正式使用前了解导出与可选同步: Try it without signing up. Data stays in the current browser by default. Review export and optional sync before relying on it for your training records.

Codex Quota 把五小时额度、周额度、重置时间和近五天消耗趋势放到 ma: Codex Quota puts five-hour and weekly limits, reset times and a five-day usage trend on your macOS desktop. A glance helps you decide whether to continue or plan the next task.
Codex Quota 中号和小号组件示意: Codex Quota medium and small widget previews
近五天 token 消耗趋势: Token usage over the last five days
像系统状态一样自然地留在桌面，而不是打断工作的另一块仪表盘。: A natural part of your desktop, like system status, without another dashboard interrupting your work.
当 Codex 成为高频协作工具，隐藏在设置页里的额度会直接影响任务怎么拆、什么: When Codex becomes a frequent collaborator, limits hidden in settings affect how you split tasks and when to continue or switch work. Codex Quota reduces that check to a quick glance at your desktop.
为 macOS 上的 Codex 重度用户设计。: Built for frequent Codex users on macOS.
少一次上下文切换，多保留一点专注。它不替你管理工作，只把真正影响工作的信息放到眼: One less context switch helps you stay focused. It keeps the information that affects your work in view, while leaving task management to you.
小号组件保留当下最关键的额度值；中号组件补充周限额、重置时间和近期趋势，信息深度: The small widget emphasizes the current quota. The medium widget adds weekly limits, reset times and recent trends, with detail suited to each size.
把瞬时额度变成可理解的趋势: Put the current quota in context
除了剩余百分比，还汇总最近五个已完成自然日的 token 消耗与日均值，帮助你理: Alongside the remaining percentage, see token consumption and a daily average across the last five completed calendar days.
本地读取，缩小数据边界: Read locally. Keep the data boundary small.
菜单栏 App 负责读取官方额度接口和本机 Codex 日志，桌面 Widget: The menu bar app reads the official quota endpoint and local Codex logs. The desktop widget consumes only a sanitized local snapshot, without direct access to authentication files.
